reviews.text:
Convenient because it's near my house, otherwise I'm a big fan of Teddy Wash, a combination of the two would be perfect!

But I'm delighted to be able to wash my dog ​​in a place like this; the towels and sink are a nice bonus!

Update: May 8, 2026, a public holiday, I took advantage of it, not knowing if I'd find the place open or closed. And it was open! So great! I would have understood if it had been closed, and I think they should have...!

In short, I started washing my dog, everything was fine, then I felt the water flow slow down a bit. I thought, "Okay, it'll stop soon, I'll run it again to make sure I rinse him properly." I paid, and miraculously, nothing worked anymore—not the drying, not the rinsing, not the disinfection... Nothing... I called the number, "not available, send a text message." I sent my first text at 11:48 AM... it's 1:10 PM and I still haven't heard anything. My €3 down the drain, and I'm not even sure I rinsed my dog ​​properly. So I'm taking off a star.

UPDATE 06/28: IT'S CLOSED! Well, I've completely lost my €3, but what's worse, the bathtub inside isn't even there anymore, and the curtain is closed! Is it a bathtub replacement or is it closed for good?! We'll see...

The credit card didn't work.
The dog wash wasn't clean; there was a lot of hair left by previous users.
It didn't seem like any shampoo or conditioner was being dispensed.
Given the current heatwave, the water was quite hot.
And I think the room is in a bad state; the metal is rusty, it looks a bit abandoned or at least not maintained.

The place looked nice, and even though it was a bit dirty when I arrived, there's a free rinsing system to use before starting, so no complaints there. The one-star rating is because I paid €10, couldn't use the machine because it was faulty, and received no response to my numerous calls and emails.

Let me explain: I paid €10 and there was no shampoo left (I have video evidence), and then the machine was faulty because it was giving my partner, my dog, and me strong electric shocks. We had to use towels to remove our dog's fur without risking getting shocks in our fingers and arms; it was surreal... I called the number 10 times and sent emails—because beyond the €10 I lost, the safety of the owners and their dogs is at stake—but no response! It's a disgrace! I absolutely do not recommend this place, and I will advise my entire dog-walking group in Marseille's 9th arrondissement to stop going there.

A simple response would have made all the difference, but this ignorance is serious, unprofessional, and dangerous given the situation.

Run away, it's a scam.

€10 for water and drying... no shampoo, the dog area is filthy, the phone number to contact someone is no longer in service... easy, they take your money and then we'll see.
Perfect for a good cleaning of the little one

I came this morning with my Belgian Malinois who needed a good shampoo. He's very sociable, but I couldn't take him to a groomer; I'm not sure he'd appreciate it.
This alternative is fantastic! He had a great time, the products available do the job, thank you for existing, Sun smells good again ☺️.

Simple and effective!

And the owner is responsive and answered my call and questions!
Perfect, clean, practical, and above all, compared to its competitor, the place is covered, essential in winter, and there's an access ramp... 10 minutes, €10, QED... I'll be back...

Honestly, I don't really understand the negative reviews. I just tried it for the first time today. I really appreciated the comfort the system provides. No more shampooing the dog in the shower at home, bending over, water everywhere when he shakes himself off, and then the chore of cleaning up. Here, you have hot water, warm air, everything you need to brush him before and after, and a ramp to the shower tray at the right height. My only regret is not having known about this system sooner. For example, for my 30 kg dog, it only cost me 13 euros.

On November 2nd, I went there to get my Belgian Malinois groomed!

Thinking the system was efficient, saving me a trip to the groomer... and why not come back?

What a mistake!!!

The facility is clean, there's nail clippers, a brush, a sink to wash your hands, a bowl for the dog. My first impression was very positive; the service is well thought out, but it's a rip-off!

There's no water pressure to rinse the animal, the water is barely lukewarm, which is uncomfortable for us.

The foaming jet is a disaster.

I paid €23 to a "company" and my dog ​​wasn't even completely clean. It took me over 5 minutes to lather her up!

Almost 10 minutes to rinse her!

Eight minutes to get her less wet.

I'm still waiting for a call back from the manager, and there's been no goodwill gesture whatsoever...

This is the last time I'll go there, which is a real shame because the idea is brilliant!

But the business is completely mismanaged!

I would have paid €30 to have my dog ​​groomed professionally and would have had a human hand do the work instead of a machine.
Had my dog ​​washed there. Nice and useful place.

When I see all these negative comments, I think to myself that humans are never satisfied. You can provide everything, but they'll always feel like they're missing something. At a groomer's, it costs €40-€60, and here it's between €10-€15. So instead of complaining, take this moment as a pleasure you share with your pet. As for you owners, you're courageous because I know it's a significant investment, and on top of that, you have to put up with these bitter people, despite all your efforts to create a fantastic concept. Good luck to you and best wishes for the future.

As a customer since this place opened, I've noticed a significant decline in quality over the past few months. There was a time when towels (and even disposable aprons) were provided. I can understand that they were discontinued to reduce costs. Unfortunately, what's essential when washing your dog—the washing machine itself—has also deteriorated. Over the past few months, the shower head was either faulty (didn't stay attached to the hose) or the spray patterns weren't adjustable. Now, the only available spray settings (...streams of water...) make the shampooing and rinsing process EXTREMELY LONG, resulting in a MUCH higher cost (double the time required).

I wonder to what extent the deterioration of the shower head (limited choice of spray patterns) isn't intentional 🤔
In short, I'm going to look for another dog wash 😞
No pressure, it takes 1000 years to wash a long-haired dog in there.

Caution: For older and heavy dogs, it would be helpful to replace your slippery ramp with proper access stairs! Otherwise, it's a very practical and clean place for our beloved dogs! Ventilation would be a welcome addition.
Very practical, but the water jet lacks a bit of pressure for a large, long-haired dog.
Very clean and well equipped

The place is very clean and has useful accessories for grooming our canine friends. However, be sure to bring enough cash as there are no ATMs nearby. It's a shame there are so few dog washes in Marseille.

Great concept.
It's a shame there were no more towels and the brushes were full of hair, but otherwise everything went well.

I really appreciated this place for washing my dog. It was clean, with towels available and reasonably priced.

Of course, before giving up my spot to a gentleman who was waiting, I cleaned everything: the tub, the table, and the floor. Just what you need to do! 👌

I 100% recommend this place!!!
It's very clean, and they have everything you need to take care of your pets!!!
The manager is available for any problem and resolves it quickly and efficiently—top-notch!!!
My wife and I are delighted to come and bathe our dogs at this shop!

Thank you 😁👍
Appalling... CB radio broken! Seriously! Very dirty, both the tank and the room, the water jet is weak, the dryer blows out freezing air!! Typical Marseilles style...

Avoid at all costs… filthy, pet hair everywhere! The sink wasn't cleaned, and the brushes provided weren't cleaned either. The floor was rotten, and to top it all off, the water was barely lukewarm, the dryer was practically cold, and there …
Not very clean, no water pressure, in short, very expensive if you have a medium-sized dog or larger. …

AVOID AT ALL COSTS!!! 14 euros wasted.
The premises are filthy, the dog chain was broken, and the towels were filthy. …

Always very convenient.
Good value for money.
My dog ​​often comes here after long hikes. …
Perfect for washing your dog. The table and accessories are OK for grooming, but it's missing a power outlet for clippers 🐶 …
Very good! Well-equipped, towels provided. One small drawback: the vending machine didn't work with credit card payments, and I'd promised my dog ​​a treat.

Very disappointed compared to the beginning, dirty, no towels! I paid €10 to wash a French bulldog, so not a big one, and after 6 minutes of drying, he's still soaking wet! Honestly, last time at this price for this result!
